---
name: Claim audit
about: A number in the README looks unsupported or unmatched
title: "[audit] "
labels: ["honesty"]
---

**Which claim?**
Quote the line from README.md or measured.json.

**What is missing?**
- [ ] matched parameter count
- [ ] matched training schedule
- [ ] baseline not run
- [ ] too few seeds
- [ ] synthetic-only task presented as general
- [ ] other

**What would settle it?**
Describe the minimal experiment. If the answer is "we cannot run it yet",
the correct fix is to mark the claim INCOMPLETE, not to delete the caveat.
